title: Measure of a Man
description: A teen develops a bond with a Wall Street executive while learning to stand up to bullies during one life-changing summer.

title: Turtle Tale
description: Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.

title: Jurassic Park
description: In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.

title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
description: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

title: Jurassic Park III
description: After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives.

title: A Mermaid's Tale
description: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

title: Bernie the Dolphin
description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

title: Bernie the Dolphin 2
description: The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

title: Leo the Lion
description: A young vegetarian lion is shunned by other carnivores.

title: Beautiful Wave
description: A New York teen (Aimee Teegarden) discovers a family secret while spending the summer in California with her estranged grandmother (Patricia Richardson).

title: Bandslam
description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

title: I Can Only Imagine 2
description: After the success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame starts to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life.

title: Time Freak
description: Dumped by his girlfriend, a young physics genius travels back in time to change the past and win her heart again.
